prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Pet Creation: Move sign-in after pet selection and photo upload so users create their companion before committing to an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Preview Grid: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split stage layout with animated previews and rich choice cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"type": "choice_cards", "role": "pet_choices", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "preview", "role": "pet_choices", "asset": "asset:pet_preview_anim"}]}}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Guide Screen: Insert a dedicated controls guide screen before completion explaining how to summon, move, and hide the desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_guide", "home_intro"], "new_controls_guide": {"headline": "How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Click your pet to interact, drag to position anywhere on your screen, and right-click for options.", "layout": "card"}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Generation Preset Fallback: Introduce visual preset selection cards on the photo upload screen as a reliable fallback if custom photo processing fails.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "If custom photo upload stalls, select a styled preset companion to continue instantly.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose", "label": "Use Instant Pet Preset"}]}}
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Spawn Progress & Tips: Add an explicit progress bar, estimated time remaining, and tip carousel to the waiting screen while desktop pet assets render.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing your desktop pet companion...", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "calm"}]}}
5: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud Save Protected Sign-In Callout: Display explicit cloud backup trust badges on the sign-in screen highlighting protection against pet progress loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Pet to Cloud", "body": "Sign in to keep your custom pet safe and sync progress across all updates.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Cloud Backup Protected", "style": "highlight"}]}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Streamlined Value Proposition Story Copy: Update initial story headline and body text to immediately explain what a desktop pet companion does.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Adopt Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "body": "Bring an adorable animated pet to life on your desktop to keep you company and enhance your workflow.", "button_label": "Get Started"}}
7: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Checklist Layout: Reframe the adoption certificate screen into a checklist layout summarizing name, personality traits, and desktop permissions.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Finalize Your Adoption Certificate", "show_step_counter": true}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification: Enable desktop system notifications and explicit status text so users know when their pet has loaded on the screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to appear!"}}
9: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Shortcut Visual Hint: Add a visual hotkey badge and interactive hint on the home intro screen showing how to summon the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon your pet to the front of your desktop.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Hotkey: Ctrl+Shift+P", "style": "emphasis"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet creation is explicitly allowed within onboarding.
Redesigned pet selection layout still fulfills the job of choosing a pet.
Adding a controls guide screen within onboarding is allowed.
Adding preset fallback choice cards to the photo upload screen is permitted.
Adding progress indicators and tips during a real wait is permitted.
Adding trust badges to the sign-in screen is allowed and complies with fair design rules.
Updated story copy continues to fulfill the job of introducing the pet.
Reframe to a checklist layout loses the official stamp required for the adoption certificate screen.
Adding system notifications and timing info to the waiting screen is permitted.
Adding hotkey visual hints to the home intro overlay is allowed within onboarding.
